title: Synchronisation error - changes NS profile are not correct synched to AndroidAPS
symptom: When switching from 4 IC values per day to hourly based IC values in the Nightscout profile editor, the hourly values are correct on Nightscout but on AndroidAPS new entries appear without time information, requiring manual addition. Also, the timestamp since the profile is in place is not correct.
cause: The user likely violated the rule 'Record modification from NS is not allowed' by modifying an existing profile entry in the Nightscout profile editor instead of cloning it.
fix: The user should follow the release notes instructions, which imply that profile modifications from NS are not allowed; instead, they should clone the entry before making changes.
evidence_quote: I think I violated "Record modification from NS is not allowed" when I changed the profile with Nightscout profile editor if I understand this right.
